headline: **MLB Daily Recap: July 27, 2026**
article:
The Seattle Mariners suffered a 7-3 loss to the Texas Rangers, with Joc Pederson leading the offense with 2 hits, 2 home runs, and 4 RBIs. Kumar Rocker earned the win for the Rangers, pitching 6.2 innings with 7 strikeouts and 2 earned runs.

Several key players have been placed on the injured list, including Kerry Carpenter of the Detroit Tigers, who has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to left foot plantar fasciitis. Other players affected by injuries include Spencer Steer of the Cincinnati Reds, Cody Bellinger of the New York Yankees, Shea Langeliers of the Athletics, Mike Paredes of the Minnesota Twins, Josh Jung of the Texas Rangers, Spencer Arrighetti of the Houston Astros, and Juan Soto of the New York Mets.

The Pittsburgh Pirates have made a significant move, acquiring right fielder Johnathan Rodríguez in a trade with the Baltimore Orioles. Rodríguez joins the Pirates' outfield, adding depth to the team.

top_news.title: **Mariners Fall to Rangers in 7-3 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners suffered a 7-3 defeat at the hands of the Texas Rangers, with Joc Pederson leading the offense with 2 hits, 2 home runs, and 4 RBIs. Kumar Rocker earned the win for the Rangers, pitching 6.2 innings with 7 strikeouts and 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Orioles Take Down Tigers 8-5**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured an 8-5 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Coby Mayo leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. Rico Garcia earned the save and also recorded 2 strikeouts in 1 inning of work.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Diamondbacks in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates edged out the Arizona Diamondbacks 3-2 in a closely contested game. Max Kepler led the Diamondbacks' offense with 3 hits and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Marlins Walk Off in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins edged out the Philadelphia Phillies 8-7 in a back-and-forth game. Heriberto Hernández led the Marlins' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Kerry Carpenter Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Detroit Tigers right fielder Kerry Carpenter has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to left foot plantar fasciitis.

top_news.title: **Pirates Acquire Rodríguez in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates have acquired right fielder Johnathan Rodríguez in a trade with the Baltimore Orioles, who received cash in return. The move adds depth to the Pirates' outfield.
